slices.focus: Ariana and Felicia redesign the permissions packet into tiered access options for families
slices.summary: Ariana works with Dr. Felicia Mercer to rewrite the permissions packet into three tiers: reading-room only, short public clips, and full online publication. Previously stalled families re-engage because they have narrower, understandable options.
open_loops: Writing a short spoken script for explaining the three tiers at kitchen-table conversations
Adding access level as a primary field in the tracking board
Setting up a review pathway so families know choices are not frozen forever
